notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color you have devotion to.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Nyx Lotus and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.
